data.content_ref: inline:The target conflates inter-rater convergence with reliability gain, but convergence on a counter-intuitive checklist item is still consistent with mere compliance: panelists could converge because the checklist told them all to mark the same item, not because the checklist causally improved their judgment process. The target provides no causal mechanism linking convergence to genuine reliability versus coordinated compliance tracking the right answer, failing the problem's explicit requirement to distinguish the two within a single evaluation.
